description: An abstract PHP class defining common database operations for MySQL, including insert, delete, update, and search functionalities, intended to serve as a base repository class for other specific repositories.

classes.name: MysqlRepository
classes.description: An abstract class providing common database operation methods for MySQL, designed to be extended by concrete repository classes.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Assigns a logger instance to the repository for logging purposes.

methods.name: executeInsertStatement
methods.description: Executes a prepared insert statement and returns the ID of the inserted row.

methods.name: generateParamTypes
methods.description: Generates a string of parameter types for prepared statements based on column names.

methods.name: deleteByTableId
methods.description: Deletes a record from a specified table by its ID.

methods.name: deleteByTableIds
methods.description: Deletes multiple records from a specified table by their IDs.

methods.name: updateByTableId
methods.description: Updates a record in a specified table by its ID with new column values.

methods.name: searchAll
methods.description: Performs a search query with optional pagination and ordering, returns an array of results.

methods.name: countSearchResults
methods.description: Counts the total number of search results matching the criteria.

methods.name: getBaseSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Abstract method to get a base SQL select query builder.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the total number of records matching the search criteria.
